content_text:
給新手：幾何佈局MOD
按鍵盤Ｂ鍵打開設定
左上角keybinds可以改快捷鍵（默認即可）
右上角模組ON開﹑OFF關。
左邊第一欄AxisAligned = 調整網格形狀
．日常使用默認第一個正方形會自動對齊
左邊第二欄DefaultCamer = 45°對齊方式
．日常用不到但在建家時搭配著使用會達到更好看的效果
中間欄位Colors自訂顏色不用調整有需要自行設置
．NearestTile 可選hide = 方便數地皮
右邊欄位Other
．✓ 第一個 網格顯示開關 打開，關掉會隱藏網格模組仍然生效
．△第二個 物品投影開關，開關皆可
．△第三個 物品圖標的顯示開關，關閉會隱藏拿在手上的圖標，在點一次會隱藏數量
．✗第四、第五提供更多種植點位、提供耕地上面的網格，關閉。
PS.要是在種植時不想對齊網格可按Ctrl讓模組暫時失效，其餘默認即可

放置物体时自动对齐网格，并显示建造网格（按住Ctrl键时除外）。
▌配置选项
在模组界面选中本模组后，点击"配置"按钮可调整以下设置：
Ctrl键切换网格：
开启：默认不显示网格，按住Ctrl时显示
关闭（默认）：默认显示网格，按住Ctrl时隐藏
选项按钮
设置打开游戏内模组选项菜单的快捷键。键盘默认键为B键。手柄用户可在计分板界面按下左摇杆（LS）打开，也可通过重绑定Menu Misc 3键修改。
切换按钮
快速切换最近使用的几何布局（若无法识别当前环境——通常只发生在地表与洞穴间传送或刚加入游戏时，将自动推测）。键盘默认键为V键，手柄无默认绑定。
吸附网格按钮
将网格点对齐到光标下的物体或地块关键点（中心/边缘/角落，技术上属于地块内的5x5网格点）。键盘默认未绑定，手柄无绑定。

In knownfoods.lua line 521, when replace a tag for another tag, it is not correct to replace with 1 tag by default. You should do something like this:
-- try to replace mintag with a new tag
for tag,_ in pairs(_alltags) do
if tag ~= mintag then
local max_num = recipe.maxtags[tag] ~= nil and recipe.maxtags[tag]-0.25 or 4
mintags[tag] = mintags[tag] and mintags[tag]+max_num or max_num
if _ptest(test,minnames,mintags) == 1 then
local amount = mintags[tag]
mintags[tag] = nil
if _ptest(test, minnames, mintags) == 1 then -- _Test[nil] == true, not a required tag
recipe.mintags[tag] = nil
else -- _Test[nil] == false, mintag is required
mintags[tag] = amount - _dtag
if _ptest(test, minnames, mintags) ~= 1 then -- _Test[amount-1] == false, valid mintag

content_text:
I know the author stopped supporting this mod, I'm still using it because it's working in my world. It was making my game crash during the Moonstorm event though.
This fix worked for me:
1. Go to workshop-375850593 folder and create a backup copy of modmain.lua
2. Edit the modmain.lua file to include this (I added it at line 69):
-- Fix for moonstorm crash - ensure isexternallyinsulated exists properly
AddComponentPostInit("inventory", function(self)
if self.isexternallyinsulated == nil then
-- Create a simple object that mimics the expected interface
self.isexternallyinsulated = {
Get = function() return false end  -- Return false = not insulated
}
end
end)
3. Save the file, reload the game, re-attempt.

content_text:
I actually fixed the beard storage Wilson issue myself. You need to re-add the beard slot to the equipment slots table in the mods code.
The fix is simple:
1 - Go to the game mods folder, "<steam installation folder>\steamapps\common\Don't Starve Together\mods";
2 - Find this mod folder, for me was "workshop-375850593", and open it;
3 - In the folder, open the archive "modmain.lua" in a text editor, and find the table for the equipment slots, for me it was:
GLOBAL.EQUIPSLOTS = {
HANDS = "hands",
HEAD = "head",
BODY = "body",
BACK = "back",
NECK = "neck",
WAIST = "waist"
}
4 - Add the beard again to this table, just like this:
GLOBAL.EQUIPSLOTS = {
HANDS = "hands",
HEAD = "head",
BODY = "body",
BACK = "back",
BEARD = "beard", -- Added line to resolve Wilson compatibility
NECK = "neck",
WAIST = "waist"
}
5 - Save the file and close it, and you should be good to go.
For me this fixed the Wilson issue... hope this helps someone!!!

从盗版时代的汉化破解版，到转正后在Steam玩饥荒，这是陪伴我时间最久的一个Mod了，真的非常感谢汉化组的辛勤付出（我自己现在也有在做一些简单的翻译工作）。
这次“DST”十周年，我和朋友回来看看的时候，发现游戏一直崩溃，排错时我还以为是汉化包跟官中已经不兼容了，但后来发现并不是，但评论区好像也没人说这件事，所以我决定留个评论给后人指指路（？）。
我至今印象最深刻的，还是加载界面的那个“祈祷中”，还有“人物状态展示”Mod里的“我的大脑处于巅峰状态！”和“我去！血槽满了！”，真的很有意思ww

content_text: Unfortunately, the game encodes all stack sizes in an array of five items (the stack size types) and only saves the index of that array for clients. Therefore, changing the stack size for an item to a value that is not in the array would crash the game. The only way to influence the array would be to overwrite the stackable_replica.lua file, but this would probably break on future updates, so I wouldn't recommend doing so.

After some consideration and much speculation (seriously, send error reports) as to why some of you seem to be experiencing incompatibilities with this mod, I have now added a new experimental option that attempts to enforce the new values from the tuning table on all prefabs. In some cases, this could solve certain problems with other mods, but it could also make them worse(it probably depends on mod load order), so this option is disabled by default.
There are three options: You can use standard mode or force mode. If neither of these work, you should disable this mod or the conflicting mod.
However, any mod that modifies stack sizes in tuning or influences stackable.lua or stackable_replica.lua is probably incompatible with this mod.

content_text:
This is a step by step on how to add the new /tiphat emote to your gesture wheel if you can't wait for an update.
1. Find the mod's file in your workshop folder.
2. Open each of the 3 files listed below in some text editor and add each line of code to the specified file under the correct list. Don't forget the commas.
In modinfo/lua, add this to  local eight_actions under -- Unlockable emotes:
{description = "/tiphat",   data = "tiphat"},
In modmain.lua, add this to local EMOTES_ITEMS:
{name = "tiphat",   anim = {anim="emote_hat_tip"},      item = "emote_tiphat"},
In scripts/widgets/gesturebadge.lua, add this to local positions:
emote_hat_tip = {
offsetx = 5
},
3. Refresh your mods.
If the changes get overridden then make a copy of the mod in your mods folder and add the changes there. Make sure that you're using the right version in your mods list if you make a copy.

In modinfo/lua, add this to local eight_actions under -- Unlockable emotes:

In modmain.lua, add this to local EMOTES_ITEMS:

content_text:
▋新增
1、“新奥尔良烤翅”重做为“飞福果煎”(但贴图来不及重绘了，下次更新会完成的）。食用效果改为提供12分钟的15%移速提升，最多叠加到15分钟。同时，移除了“蝙蝠伪装buff”
2、棱镜的4种花瓣都可以进行晾晒了，并且也兼容了花瓣的专属料理
▋改动与优化
1、盾牌改动
▷一次举盾过程中，对同个敌人的反伤次数有上限(=1 + 装备者的盾牌额外反伤次数 + 所持盾牌的盾牌额外反伤次数)
▷犀金胄甲触发套装效果时，装备者的盾牌额外反伤次数+1
▷“艾力冈的剑”的盾牌额外反伤次数为1（其余盾牌均为0）
2、鸳鸯石被玩家携带时，温度变化会延缓(每变化0.4度，恢复0.15度)
3、犀金胄甲也能在巨石枝砸下来时进行缓冲了
4、新版本的装备已全部加入幻化
▋修复
1、修复了盾反时可能会无限盾反的问题(这次彻底修好了)
2、修正了鸳鸯石的代码

content_text:
▋改动与优化
1、灵魂契约的优化(哈哈，真是改了又改)
▷除了沃托克斯，契约不会再尝试往其他角色的物品栏放入多余的灵魂
▷契约往物品栏放入灵魂时会将多余的灵魂自动放入灵魂罐，并且能兼容灵魂罐对灵魂叠加上限的提升
▷提取灵魂和存储灵魂时，不会再自动释放多余灵魂
▷优化了灵魂被吸引逻辑。灵魂不会再被 已存满灵魂的契约以及与其绑定的玩家 吸引了；如果灵魂被绑定了契约的沃托克斯吸引，则会按照官方吸引逻辑进行

content_text:
Original author: simplex
Online version of behavior queuing theory
Client MOD
Press the SHIFT box to select, automatically execute actions on the selected objects, such as cutting trees and digging mines.
After the box is selected, if the character is stuck in one action, move the character and re frame it.
The difference from the non - online version:
Support the cooking of fire
Support seed on the farm
Support the addition of fuel
No birds
The clipping target will not be the player
Support automatic planting
It supports automatic picking up actions after cutting trees and so on. It needs to be opened in mod settings.
Support automatic repeat production and press SHIFT click recipe. (the function can be closed with over configuration)
content_html:
Original author: simplex
Online version of behavior queuing theory
Client MOD
Press the SHIFT box to select, automatically execute actions on the selected objects, such as cutting trees and digging mines.
After the box is selected, if the character is stuck in one action, move the character and re frame it.
The difference from the non - online version:
Support the cooking of fire
Support seed on the farm
Support the addition of fuel
No birds
The clipping target will not be the player
Support automatic planting
It supports automatic picking up actions after cutting trees and so on. It needs to be opened in mod settings.
Support automatic repeat production and press SHIFT click recipe. (the function can be closed with over configuration)

content_text:
@VIktor Stars have a _pulsetime netvar which corresponds to how long it has been alive. It's only updated every 30 seconds or so, but it's a pretty small interval when you compare it to how long the star lasts.
Also, the Extra-Adorable Lavae's light directly corresponds to its hunger value. I've just been using a customcommand to see it myself since I deemed it too minor to make a full mod out of, but it would be a great fit for this mod.
Honestly I was considering making a bulk mod with these and stuff like campfires until I found that you beat me to it. So here, take my research; use it wisely :P
If you ever feel like branching out from light/fire, consider adding timers for stuff like watches on the ground. Would be helpful for second chances on cooldown :)
content_html:
@VIktor Stars have a _pulsetime netvar which corresponds to how long it has been alive. It's only updated every 30 seconds or so, but it's a pretty small interval when you compare it to how long the star lasts.

Also, the Extra-Adorable Lavae's light directly corresponds to its hunger value. I've just been using a customcommand to see it myself since I deemed it too minor to make a full mod out of, but it would be a great fit for this mod.

Honestly I was considering making a bulk mod with these and stuff like campfires until I found that you beat me to it. So here, take my research; use it wisely :P

If you ever feel like branching out from light/fire, consider adding timers for stuff like watches on the ground. Would be helpful for second chances on cooldown :)

@Scriturs: The Star Caller Staff does not have any visible indicator telling me the exact time until it goes off (unlike Campfire or Lantern whose light range depends on their fuel value) and the star can last for 3.5 days unlike regular fires who last for less than one min, so I can neither ask the Star about its duration nor count until it is supposed to go off.

Adding Star Caller's Staff time could be possible, but it would also mean alot of work if you include things like Server Lag (not noticeable as client), Rollbacks, etc. even the clock on the top right won't always tell you the correct timing and depending on lag, a day in caves might take more or less than eight minutes. And if the Star gets casted offscreen, then I can't offer you more than a rough estimation about its timing.

TL;DR: It would be possible but it would take much more work and would be less precise than the other timers.

content_text:
Hi, I tried to add the palmcone lv3 chop support and it works on my side.
It's actually quite simple, just add "palmconetree" to the "CherryPick" function.
so it's like:
---
function ActionQueuer:CherryPick(rightclick)
...
elseif (self.last_click.prefab == "evergreen" or
self.last_click.prefab == "deciduoustree"
self.last_click.prefab == "moon_tree" or
self.last_click.prefab == "twiggytree" or
self.last_click.prefab == "evergreen_sparse" or -- lvl 3 Lumpy Evergreen
self.last_click.prefab == "palmconetree") and --  lvl 3 palmcone trees
self.last_click.action == ACTIONS.CHOP and
....
---
I also added Lumpy Evergreens. I guess not many people care about it but i added it anyways.
And I added support to "WAX" giant crops. Simply add "WAX" and the end of left click list.
---
AddActionList("leftclick", "ADDFUEL", ... , "WAX")
---

content_text: @Mr.Big, no, it's not possible to turn it off. It's based on the client sending the action to the server, so it's based on whatever speed that would take. AddAction("leftclick", "PICK", function(target)
return target.prefab ~= "flower_evil"
end)
So it's specifically making evil flowers an exception to the PICK action. However, you can create your own local version of the mod and modify the code if you want.
If you make a local copy of the mod, the mod will automatically rename itself to add " -dev" to the mod's name. Then you can edit the code and try different things out on your own.

content_text:
Transparency is enabled with only colors enabled to fix it change the colord line towards the end of the modmain.lua to
"local colord = (_G.SHANG_RUOYINXIAN) and .1 + math.random() * .9 or 1"
after this you can have colored rocks without transparency.
You can also adjust the "inst.AnimState:SetMultColour(colora, colorb, colorc, colord)" line to have "1" in place of colord.
Hope this helps anyone who needed an answer to this :)

content_text:
I don't think that's due to Status Announcements, but rather due to netvars in the inventory_classifieds. Status Announcements is client-only, so it's at the mercy of what the game code networks to the client already.
You'd have to go out of your way to limit to 4096 in Lua, because all numbers are floating points. But the netvars go through the game's C engine so they use some more compact numbers for those.

content_text:
Hmm... 4096 is not a limit that would be imposed by Lua (the language the game logic and mod is written in), because it uses floating-point number types only. If it's getting 4096 I'm guessing that the game engine (which is C++ and may be doing clever things with using only a certain number of bits) is limiting it.
I'm using the container:Has function, which is what the game normally uses to check if you have enough ingredients for a crafting recipe. Looks like that in turn is calling stackable:StackSize, which gets synced between client and server by stackable_replica, which is using a "smallbyte" to represent the stack amount, and that's a 6-bit unsigned integer (maximum value 63). Not sure how the elasto chest mod is getting around this but maybe they're doing something clever by also syncing a count of full stacks?
So... might be possible, but I don't see how to do it with a client-only mod, because you'd have to get into server-client syncing code.

content_text:
This is an awesome minimap mod.
I'll try to keep using it but the missing scroll-wheel zoom is a big problem - I would often change it quickly with the other minimap mod, especially when running from mobs, lol. Please find out how to add it! Maybe ask the person who made the other minimap mod, and then this mod will be perfect!!
BTW, I think there are two ways to improve resizing so that it feels better!
When resizing, the map may also change its zoom. It would be good if the map doesn't zoom so that we are not distracted and can easily pick the exact size we want.
Second, it resizes from its center, which is not typical and can ruin the position and alignment we wanted. (0,0) should be a corner, so maybe the top left or top right corner should *not* move when resizing.
Simple summary of my hopes:
1. prevent changes in the map's zoom while resizing.
2. set coordinates (0,0) to a corner so that resizing is more predictable.
Thank you!

content_text:
Thank you for reporting.
I will not reproduce it, so please tell me the detailed situation.
First, the small map saves the configuration data when the mouse hover comes off and the hover UI is hidden. If you keep the UI displayed, it will not be saved.
Next, check if the file has been saved.
Where to save DST(Klei) setting data,
/Klei/DoNotStarveTogether/{number}
For Windows, /My Documents/Klei/
For Linux,
/Home/.klei/
From there, we aim for mod_config_data.
/.klei/DoNotStarveTogether/{number}/client_save/mod_config_data/
It contains multiple modconfiguration_workshop-{number}. If there is a smallmap(cap is all lowercase) file in this, it means that it has been saved.
If you do not have write permission, you cannot save the file because you cannot create it.
These are the two possibilities I can think of.
What is the OS? Windows? What is the version?
Keyboard and mouse? Controller only?
I have some small questions, but please tell me the answers as much as possible.

content_text:
[h1] Para los que dicen que el mod no funciona:	[/h1] El mod fue creado cuando el juego de DST se encontraba en beta, todo el contenido que tenia el juego en ese entonces así como el menu de inicio fue traducido en su momento, Este mod no es actualizado desde el 2014, por lo cual mucho contenido incluido en el juego como cambio de dialogos, implementacion de objetos, interacciones de personajes, la nueva interfaz de inicio y demás cosas quedaron fuera de la version, de esta forma este mod se ah ido quedando obsoleta.
Mi recomendación:
-Usar el mod solo como guía dentro del servidor de juego, (ya que adentro del juego hay partes que siguen estando traducidas y puedes guiarte de eso para entender lo demas del juego, que en su mayoria es ingles muy básico,)
-Buscar otro mod de traduccion, hay varios actualmente, personalmente desconosco hasta que punto están bien traducidos porque actualmente no uso ninguno de ellos.

content_text:
Hello, I really love this mod! It's been very helpful for stacking a lot of things that the mod I used to use didn't cover. Thank you for all your hard work on this! :)
I would also like to report a bug. It is only with Moles and Carrats. If stacking is enabled for these creatures and I pick them up, when I put them down again they will begin to starve and remain as "starving" forever. Feeding them does not change that they are starving. If I pick them up again once they are starving, they will instantly die in my inventory.
Turning off stacking for Moles and Carrats in a new world prevents the issue. But in an existing world where I already picked up and placed back down a Mole or Carrat they will continue to starve, even with the stacking for them now disabled in that world.
Also, I was wondering if it would be possible to add a setting for Willow's embers like Wortox's souls, so that you can stack more than the default setting?
Thank you so much!
content_html:
Hello, I really love this mod! It's been very helpful for stacking a lot of things that the mod I used to use didn't cover. Thank you for all your hard work on this! :)

I would also like to report a bug. It is only with Moles and Carrats. If stacking is enabled for these creatures and I pick them up, when I put them down again they will begin to starve and remain as "starving" forever. Feeding them does not change that they are starving. If I pick them up again once they are starving, they will instantly die in my inventory.

Turning off stacking for Moles and Carrats in a new world prevents the issue. But in an existing world where I already picked up and placed back down a Mole or Carrat they will continue to starve, even with the stacking for them now disabled in that world.

Also, I was wondering if it would be possible to add a setting for Willow's embers like Wortox's souls, so that you can stack more than the default setting?

Thank you so much!

content_text:
#### **关键冲突点**
1. **Mod 覆盖原生逻辑**
- **勋章盒（workshop-1909182187）**：其自定义的 `TakeActiveItemFromAllOfSlot` 可能未正确处理物品销毁后的逻辑。
- **自动堆叠（workshop-3050607025）**：合并物品时可能未及时清理无效实体引用。
2. **无效实体残留**
物品实体被合并或移除后，其引用仍被保留在操作链中（如背包缓存、事件监听），后续操作尝试访问已失效的 `replica`。

content_text:
你好，分析到一下错误
错误发生在物品从背包或容器中移除时，尝试访问一个已被销毁的实体（`inst`）的 `replica.inventoryitem` 字段，导致 `nil` 索引。具体流程如下：
1. 玩家点击物品栏中的某个槽位（`invslot.lua` 的 `Click` 方法）。
2. 游戏尝试从槽位中取出物品（`TakeActiveItemFromAllOfSlot`）。
3. 执行 `RemoveItemBySlot` 移除物品时，触发 `inventoryitem` 组件的 `OnRemoved` 方法。
4. 在 `OnRemoved` 中调用 `ClearOwner` 方法时，`inst.replica.inventoryitem` 已被释放（`inst` 被标记为 `valid:false`），导致访问失败。

1. 玩家点击物品栏中的某个槽位（`invslot.lua` 的 `Click` 方法）。
2. 游戏尝试从槽位中取出物品（`TakeActiveItemFromAllOfSlot`）。
3. 执行 `RemoveItemBySlot` 移除物品时，触发 `inventoryitem` 组件的 `OnRemoved` 方法。
4. 在 `OnRemoved` 中调用 `ClearOwner` 方法时，`inst.replica.inventoryitem` 已被释放（`inst` 被标记为 `valid:false`），导致访问失败。

I am a player of DST and also a mod developer and sharer on the WeGame platform. Recently, I came across your mod on Steam and was deeply impressed by its creativity and functionality. I believe it would be well-received in the WeGame community.
Therefore, I am writing to request your authorization to transfer your mod to the WeGame platform. To ensure your rights and respect your original work, I will retain your name and provide detailed credit to you as the original author in the mod description. Additionally, I would like to integrate some of your mod's features and content into my own mod to enhance the overall gaming experience.
If you agree to grant permission, please let me know if you have any special requirements or considerations.
Thank you very much for considering this proposal, and I look forward to your response.
Best regards

驯化度标记的颜色反映了牛牛当前的驯化趋势，这是可以设定的，默认的样式如下所示：

注意切换设置将会覆盖当前会话的“自动显示”设置（进出洞穴或重载将会重设为原来设置的值）。


[h1] 信息 [/h1]
大多数信息都很直接地显示出来了，除了趋势和饥饿标记，所以让我来解释一下：


[h1] 驯化度和趋势 [/h1]
驯化度标记的颜色反映了牛牛当前的驯化趋势，这是可以设定的，默认的样式如下所示：
共有12种颜色可以选择（7个独特的和5个变种）。我尝试选择一些更合适的颜色，但我其实不是很擅长设计。
注意：据我所知，只有在你喂牛牛食物时才会它才会变成训好的状态。这意味着即使你的牛到了100%驯化度，你还需要喂它点吃的它才会变成训好的状态

content_text:
[h1] 骑乘计时 [/h1]
这个标记显示了你离被牛抖下来还剩多少骑乘时间。鼠标悬停在上面会显示你的鞍的剩余耐久。
注意：计时器归零时，你的鞍不会掉耐久。只有牛将鞍抖落时才会掉耐久
[h1] 饥饿度标记 [/h1]
你的牛牛在被骑乘时需要至少10点饥饿度才会显示饥饿标记（可设定）。一旦被激活，需要当牛牛的饥饿度降为0标记才会消失。
当你还在训牛时，这个值应该设置得低一点来使得它更容易被激活，但当你训好牛后，应该设置得足够高使得它永远不会出现

养鱼场是一个自我维持的食物来源。
在一天的探索中，Wilson发现了一个看起来像是旧的洗涤桶的东西。仔细检查后，他发现蜜蜂已经在上面筑了蜂箱，所以他亲爱的Wilson想要收集蜂蜜。不介意的盆水，开始收集蜂蜜，当一些掉到水，他吓了一跳。哇，好大的鱼！所以他看着水和注意的几个大的鱼。在这一点上，他决定挽救整个浴缸的蜂巢，所以他可以重建它的未来使用。蜜蜂采集花粉，所以更多的花你有更好的蜜蜂用花粉来制造蜂蜜。蜂蜜渗出从箱子上的孔洞，饲料鱼鱼然后生长繁殖。有3个生长阶段，由鱼你可以看到水里的数字表示0鱼=你可以收获0的鱼1鱼=你可以收获1的鱼2鱼=你可以收获2的鱼3鱼=你可以收获3的鱼增长的速度取决于花量附近。简单的食谱= 5板，2鱼和4只蜜蜂。无需机器。硬配方= 5板，2条鱼，4只蜜蜂，蜂巢5绳1。使用炼金术引擎。

@Houkai: Yes. It is normal vanilla game behavior that items disappear when they fall into the water. If you want to mitigate the loss when using auto-stacking, you can set the "World Auto Stack In" setting to "Existing" instead of "Newest". "Newest" stacks surrounding items into a newly spawned item stack, but if that stack ends up in the water, it'll all be destroyed. "Existing" puts newly spawned items into existing stacks, but that means the stacks don't "follow you" e.g. when you move to the next tree to chop down.
Hope this helps! ❤️

content_text:
@dvd_d8: Your English seems fine :) Thanks for the detailed report! It's something about the stackable component of one of the stacks of rocks that isn't networked. You can see that it says "inst = 126446 - rocks (valid:false)". One of the rocks-stacks is not valid, which is probably the reason for the crash.
It doesn't have anything to do with this mod, though. The log only shows the ID of this mod, because it alters the destack function on all stackable components. What goes wrong here, is communication with the server about a stack of rocks, when setting a new stack size on it in the GiveItem function used by the MoveItemFromAllOfSlot function.
This mod doesn't do anything with items that are in containers or inventories, so the error comes from another mod. If you can reliably recreate it, then try disabling a few mods at a time (NOT "Don't Starve Alone"), and see when it stops happening. It's likely one of the newest mods you've installed.
Good luck! Please report back :D

MORE UPDATE:
- TL;DR Items falling from the ceiling during earthquakes in the caves should no longer randomly disappear.
Long explanation:
If an item is currently prohibited by the game from being picked up (inventoryitem.canbepickedup is false), Auto-Stack and -Pickup will now be delayed until the game says the item can be picked up (max wait time is 10 seconds, after which Auto-Stack and -Pickup is cancelled). The canbepickedup variable is sometimes set to false by the game, e.g., when an item is part of a timed sequence, like items falling from the ceiling in the caves during and earthquake, or when they are in a state where you have to do something to them before they can be picked up, like flotsam that has to be fished.
Best regards, Ultroman the Tacoman

content_text:
UPDATE:
- Bait in traps is now ignored.
- "bird_egg" and "tallbirdegg" can now Auto Stack and -Pickup again.
- Penguins now produce a normal amount of eggs when using this mod.
- By design, auto-stacking is disabled for Twigs spawned within 8 units of Twiggy Trees, in order to keep the original game functionality of Twiggy Trees. Some hate it, so now you can disable this fix by enabling the new option "Auto Stack Twiggy Tree Twigs".
Explanation: In the original game, Twiggy Trees spawn up to 2 Twigs whenever they regrow, BUT ONLY IF there aren't already 2 (separate stacks of) Twigs near them! With auto-stacking, their Twigs keep being added to the same stack, so they keep thinking there's only 1 Twig, resulting in them producing full stacks of Twigs over time. The fix makes them work as intended, but stops ALL spawned Twigs from auto-stacking within 8 units of any Twiggy Tree. Note that their Auto-Pickup and Manual-Stacking still works!
Best regards, Ultroman the Tacoman

@Rey and @Paratoxian: Sticks dropping around Twiggy Trees intentionally do not stack, because otherwise they'll drop 40 Twigs underneath them over time, which is not how the game is supposed to work. They normally check how many stacks (of 1) are around them, and stop dropping more when there are 2. Therefore, the mod stops Twigs from auto-stacking and auto-pickup'ing when they are spawned near a Twiggy Tree. It's the same deal with the bird eggs near penguins. content_text:
Love the mod, it has helped me a lot playing with Abigail and this is what I discovered.
>The first two selections in the mod settings are Abby's Health and Attack multiplier, by default it will double both of these but for 'vanilla' Abby, turn these down to 1.
>The third option by default will make Abby attack shadow monsters and selecting the other option will turn this off.
>The last three options in order are Abby's light emission, movement speed, and health regeneration multipliers. By default, these are her vanilla stats but turning them up will multiply her stats by the correlated number.
Hope this helps, this mod is fantastic and I cannot thank the creator enough for making the shadow creatures fear me instead of them!
content_html:
Love the mod, it has helped me a lot playing with Abigail and this is what I discovered.

>The first two selections in the mod settings are Abby's Health and Attack multiplier, by default it will double both of these but for 'vanilla' Abby, turn these down to 1.

>The last three options in order are Abby's light emission, movement speed, and health regeneration multipliers. By default, these are her vanilla stats but turning them up will multiply her stats by the correlated number.

Hope this helps, this mod is fantastic and I cannot thank the creator enough for making the shadow creatures fear me instead of them!

推荐个mod：Upgradeable Chest -- 可升级箱子
非常滴好用，正适合像我这样的新手，以后再也不愁东西太多放不下了。
木头不够用可考虑上面那个多倍掉落mod，也不会太破坏游戏平衡。
附赠一个小技巧：
在饥荒游戏文件夹中随便找个mod文件，用记事本之类的文本编辑工具在第一行或最后一行添加一句
TUNING.PERISH_FRIDGE_MULT = -0.5
然后保存退出，你的冰箱就可以返鲜啦。妈妈再也不担心我的食物会放坏了~

content_text:
Hey again! Thanks for looking into the shadow creature aggro thing for the beta.
I'm not sure if this minor UI quirk is already ironed out in the beta, but I caught some log spam while debugging my own mod. In init_showmultiproducts.lua, the Refresh override for the crafting pinbar (and the grid list) throws a ton of Stale Component Reference warnings whenever the UI gets destroyed.
Looks like self.item_img.numtogive tries to SetString without checking if the underlying C++ entity is still alive.
Tossing a quick if not self.item_img.numtogive or not self.item_img.numtogive.inst:IsValid() then return end right before updating the string completely kills the log spam and saves some wasted CPU ticks on inventory updates.
Just dropping the code context here in case it slipped through the cracks. Cheers!

content_text:
Hey guys, love the mod! Found a side effect with shadow creature aggro you might want to check.
Currently, crawlingnightmare and ruinsnightmare (Lurking Nightmare) often drop aggro after an attack, which breaks the player's F-key auto-target and causes a jarring combat pause.
Looking at the code, it's caused by the animqueueover override in UM's SGshadowcreature.lua. The inst.components.combat:SetTarget(nil) there breaks client prediction. (nightmarebeak actually dodges this bug thanks to your terrorbeak tag check!)
Also, Klei's vanilla SGruinsnightmare.lua weirdly returns "shadowcreature" as its SG name. So UM's AddStategraphPostInit accidentally catches ruinsnightmare too, unintentionally breaking its relentless pursuit mechanic.
Not sure if the aggro drop was a deliberate difficulty tweak, but just sharing the code context in case you want to adjust it! Keep it up!
content_html:
Hey guys, love the mod! Found a side effect with shadow creature aggro you might want to check.

Currently, crawlingnightmare and ruinsnightmare (Lurking Nightmare) often drop aggro after an attack, which breaks the player's F-key auto-target and causes a jarring combat pause.

Looking at the code, it's caused by the animqueueover override in UM's SGshadowcreature.lua. The inst.components.combat:SetTarget(nil) there breaks client prediction. (nightmarebeak actually dodges this bug thanks to your terrorbeak tag check!)

Also, Klei's vanilla SGruinsnightmare.lua weirdly returns "shadowcreature" as its SG name. So UM's AddStategraphPostInit accidentally catches ruinsnightmare too, unintentionally breaking its relentless pursuit mechanic.

Not sure if the aggro drop was a deliberate difficulty tweak, but just sharing the code context in case you want to adjust it! Keep it up!

I'll explain why refried turtle.  This isn't real life, Don't starve is an alternate unforgiving world.  Nothing in this world functions like it would in real life.
The best answer for all these questions, is that it's a game, and also it's an alternate world where nothing is mean't to ever make sense.  Also remember, those bees are HUGE compared to real ones, so there's really no reason as to why they have to function the same as our normal bees anyway.
I personally feel this would make the game less challenging as getting the materials to make a beekeepers hat is usually specifically for saving resources anyway, it's 80% damage reduction from bees only for 750 health.
But again, play the game however you wish, mods are here for your own personal enjoyment, if you feel the game is more fun with these mod's then go ahead and add them.

请问有兴趣做个武器/工具的mod吗？这是我一直想要的功能
饥荒里的工具使用的时候，是把工具放到工具栏，这样就有个问题：当这个武器/工具被其他工具挤掉之后，工具会优先回到它被装备时所在的格子，但是如果这个格子被占用了（你知道随便捡点东西就可能占用这个格子了）就会像获得新物品那样找一个能放的格子放。！于是我就找不到这个工具了！我相信很多人有这样的体验：激烈的战斗中，找不到武器，找不到火把，一脸懵逼。
按固定的快捷键就能装备上对应的工具，这真是太美好了，不是吗？

content_text:
所以我觉得有几种解决思路：
1.允许玩家在Inventory和背包中选择任意格子做快捷键（如果把工具全都放在背包最后边，一般不会因为捡东西而被占用，工具还是能够回到这个格子，我下次依然可以用快捷键来装备上这个工具（因为原版快捷键只能设置到第十个格子，明显不够用））
或者获取玩家格子数并且让玩家指定最后几个格子的快捷键是更好的方式，因为玩家可能打了些增加格子的的mod
content_html:
所以我觉得有几种解决思路：
1.允许玩家在Inventory和背包中选择任意格子做快捷键（如果把工具全都放在背包最后边，一般不会因为捡东西而被占用，工具还是能够回到这个格子，我下次依然可以用快捷键来装备上这个工具（因为原版快捷键只能设置到第十个格子，明显不够用））
或者获取玩家格子数并且让玩家指定最后几个格子的快捷键是更好的方式，因为玩家可能打了些增加格子的的mod

content_text:
2.在玩家装备工具/武器后，在原先位置放一个占位的东西，并且在工具被拿下/挤下的时候，清除这个占位的东西，让工具能够回到这个格子里
3.在玩家装备工具/武器后，在原先位置放一个该工具的备份，而在工具被拿下/挤下的时候，把它的状态（如耐久）更新到它的备份上，然后销毁它。
4.直接允许为任意物品添加快捷键。。。这个是不是狠了点。（看大大之前的mod没有做游戏中UI的，所以这个放到了最后）
如果大大有时间的话，希望能够考虑下这个mod，因为我实在找不到能实现同类功能的mod，也许第四种方案是最省事的，但是我真的找不到那种mod

这模组创意太棒了！但现在列表现成的蓝图可选项太少了！建议增加联网蓝图功能，如下。
1，联网下载蓝图功能:增加一个按钮可以设置联网搜索的功能，这样方便直接联网搜索基地大厅（网站）的蓝图。离线的人就按现在的。

3，蓝图预览功能，现在需要点击后直接投影，后面蓝图多了后筛选太慢了，增加预览功能方便一眼知道最终是什么样子，做什么的。方便快速找到要的。
4，增加点赞蓝图功能（或者显示下载量），方便用户来识别哪些mod优秀。

I got an Idea how a Medigun could function balanced, first implement the gun, upon right clicking a creature, player, they will be healed 10hp every second(sounds balanced to me) If you go to far away you'll stop healing them
If you want to continue firing it, you'll need a medigun backpack, if you constantly heal, it will last for 50 seconds. after 40 seconds of healing, you can press a binded key to activate the charge for 10 seconds, this means, that 1 medigun backpack, equales 1 charge at max.
I would say the charge status should be stored in the medigun.
I dunno if this is Programmable but it would be a nice touch.
The back pack also avoids the medic players from wearing armor in battle, to make them even weaker.

An improvement would be to either give the user the option to set his loudness manually or simply having him work under the usurers default settings.
2. < Spawn rate of wumpa crates > The crates spawn way too often, and because of the effective healing it gives, it kind of breaks the game. Some may enjoy this allowing more of an easy mode but it’s not for everyone. A cool setting would be if the user could set the spawn rate before generating the world.

content_text:
This mod has an bug if you play as Wilson
It is in code ... It seems that this mod see Wilson "Backack Beard" skill as its own code or as a threat while game want to add it every time in day 3 which cause a server disconnection
While it is very dificult for game code to understande the bug ... it is easy to repair that bug
1.
You need to find folder with your game mode (for me: workshop-1818688368)
2.
Enter that folder and search for the file with name: "modmain.lua"
3.
In that file searh for: "GLOBAL.EQUIPSLOTS="
There will be a list of "extra equip slots" ... you need to add another one: BEARD = "beard",
4.
Now save the file and done ...
Have fun!
Special thanks to: MIKOTO LAW. For finding out ...

content_text:
All_clients_require_mod means that you, your friend, and everybody who wants to join your server must have the mod. That isn't a problem though because if you make a listen server(Host Game Option) that makes it so clients who join your server download it anyway. Don't worry about it basically.
Server only mod means that only the server needs the mod and no one needs to download it. Server mods don't even need to be uploaded to the workshop because the client doesnt need the mod to join your server.
Best(bleh) way of descrbing it. Hope it helps.

中文翻译：
这个mod今天放弃了，我不会更新这个或任何其他DST mods，如果有人想抓住它然后你可以自由这样做，只要给我mod的信用。
该项目将在下个月开始时删除。
不同类型的墙壁，你可以打开和关闭它们，所以它们就像一扇门。
您现在可以关闭基地区域，而不必使用锤子进出/重建墙壁。
您可以使用墙壁segemnts或他们构建的材料修复Wall Gates。
您可以一次打开/关闭最多4个细分。
只需确保使用中间段来打开/关闭它们。
如果你想要从你的基地多个入口/出口确保它们是彼此远离的2个正常墙段，所以它们不会受到其他墙门的影响。
当您将鼠标悬停在墙上时，Wall Gates和Wall Gates项目会有金色光芒。
锁定墙门和锁定墙门当鼠标悬停时，它会发出蓝光。
锁定版本的行为类似于普通的Wall Gates，但只有构建它们的人才能锁定/解锁它们。

【最新版本：v1.5.0b】
（请上传新版本的反馈信息，非常感谢！）
....（省略评论中已有翻译部分）
如果你更喜欢旧版本，信赖值系统能在配置中关闭，并且她将确切变为先前1.30版的Hibiki。每一个额外的功能也可以在mod设置中关闭。
第二艘黑海舰队驱逐舰。这是我和一些朋友着手制作的第一个相当简单的饥荒mod（因为完全缺乏舰队收藏的mods）。我最终添加了多几个对话和功能。
1.5.0版本，如果你有在你的服务器上安装修改皮肤的mod（API不懂在这里是什么意思，我个人感觉是mod的意思），Hibiki能够使用另外的皮肤。

content_text:
the cause of the crash is because the map smooth zooming include decimals for zoom amounts instead of just using integer increments
i think @Matcha 's fix is the best one
@󰀜冰河 and @ratest only work around the crash
you could try just replacing line 15 to 35 with my fix (same solution)
[code]
local PersistentMapIcons = Class(Widget, function(self, mapwidget, scale)
Widget._ctor(self, "PersistentMapIcons")
self.root = self:AddChild(Widget("root"))
self.mapicons = {}
local MapWidgetOnUpdate = mapwidget.OnUpdate
mapwidget.OnUpdate = function(mapwidget, ...)
MapWidgetOnUpdate(mapwidget, ...)
local zoomed_scale = scale - Easing.outExpo(TheWorld.minimap.MiniMap:GetZoom() - 1, 0, scale - 0.25, 8)
for _, mapicon in ipairs(self.mapicons) do
local x, y = WorldPosToScreenPos(mapicon.pos.x, mapicon.pos.z)
mapicon.icon:SetPosition(x, y)
mapicon.icon:SetScale(zoomed_scale)
end
end
end)
[/code]

content_text:
你好 默认世界单开mod时 日志里会不停刷新 Can not Find  Anim Build （1秒60条）
经排查得知是 在 property_main:UpdatePlayer中， 刚开始游戏的时候 没有获取到 base_build ，导致尝试给AnimState:SetBuild("") 然后导致一直刷新 建议修改成
--设置人物皮肤
if base_build == "" or self.last_basebuild == base_build then return end
self.last_basebuild = base_build
SetSkinsOnAnim(self.playeranim:GetAnimState(), self.owner.prefab, base_build, clothing, skin_mode)

content_text: Here's one bug that's probably always existed: if you put two g10mm3rs very close to each other, often times one g10mm3r bot will vanish while his stand and the sprite showing him mounted on it will remain, but no g10mm3r bot ever comes out to collect anything, and it can only be remedied by deconstructing/hammering that g10mm3r and re-crafting and re-placing him. Spacing them out at least half a tile in distance from each other seems to resolve this. I suspect it's because when one g10mm3r goes to his stand, the mod deletes all g10mm3r bot entities in a small area around the stand, then sets the stand to have 1/1 creatures inside. If 2 g10mm3rs are right near each other, it can delete both but only restore creature occupation for a single stand.

These little guys are excellent for all kinds of farms. Grass Gecko, Koalefant manure, Stonefruit, spider-vs-bunnyman, he even knows how to harvest honey out of bee boxes when they are at their max stage, and it won't alert the bees unlike when you do it!

content_text:
Another long-standing and easily avoided bug: deconstructing him drops an active glommer flower, and wilts any previous glommer flower you had, even if it was in a chest. Don't craft a g10mm3r with an active  glommer flower, or it will result in the live vanilla-DST glommer bug having no flower for him to follow, which can prevent a new flower from spawning on full moons because there's a live-but-oprhaned glommer bug present in the world roaming around.
Easiest way to avoid this is just make sure that you are building a g10mm3r bot always with a wilted glommer flower, not an active one, that way glommer doesn't get orphaned and have to die in order to get a new flower and respective glommer bug to spawn on the next full moon.

if food and food.components.edible and food.prefab == "fish"  then

3. overwrite save and you can level up by Fish Morsel

content_text:
@Bombobbit, That's a problem on Klei's end. Unlike most sounds, Willow's lighter has no distance requirement and will sound just as loud no matter how far you are from it. This is not normally a major problem because when a player is far enough off screen, just like most objects, they are no longer loaded and the client would never be told to play the lighter sound to begin with. But in order to function my mod forces players to always be loaded, thus there is not even a hard cut off for the sound.
TLDR: Klei made an oopsie and have not noticed it yet because it's subtle. My mod just makes it more noticeable as a side-effect.

我来渣翻下，大家凑合看。
工作原理
假设你是个游荡在避难所下等待复活的鬼魂
当你在黑暗中复活之时，避难所将为你亮起一盏温馨的小夜灯
有了光明的陪伴，你可以随心所欲而不用疑神疑鬼
当然这些都可以在MOD配置里关闭掉。
避难所还可以设置为使用5次或者无穷次数，酷吧？！
制作配方
下面有三种制作方法
初级：5木、4猪皮、四绳子，不需要科技。
中级：4胡须、2个噩梦燃料、10木，需要一级科技
高级：1个生命护符，5个噩梦燃料，10个胡须，需要二级科技
在mod配置文件里可以自行更改配方。
注：
-------------------------------------------
1.启动游戏然后选择mods选项
2.在你想设置的mod后点√
3.点√的mod如果有设置选项，右侧简介下面会有个按钮出现。
欢迎大家提出意见和建议，大家用的开心！
如果你喜欢这个mod，记得点赞！谢谢！

Annie(P)（安妮）
498383066
初始属性：100饥饿，200理智，100健康
比大多数角色跑的更慢。（存疑，这句没理解）
她相当孱弱，只造成75%的标准伤害。
技能和物品
安妮的火球
火球攻击，对目标造成30点伤害。
火球无耐久。
安妮的背包
从进入游戏开始你就能得到一个标准背包，粉红色！
安妮的小熊帽
吸收大量伤害并快速回复理智。
安妮的羽绒服
在艰苦的冬天提供强力保暖。
吸收大量伤害并快速回复理智。
安妮的红骑装
便携式冰箱，比标准冰箱容量更大。
安妮的甜心装
完美隔热，可以当做雨衣。
快速回复理智。
泰比公仔
召唤安妮最爱的宠物——泰迪魔法熊捍卫安妮的安全！
泰迪熊体型非常大，偶尔发出怒吼大范围30点伤害周围敌人，小心对安妮也会生效。
泰迪熊维持1天后重新变回熊公仔，每次召唤都需要扣除40理智和30健康。

Annie(P)（安妮）
498383066

比大多数角色跑的更慢。（存疑，这句没理解）

技能和物品
安妮的火球
火球攻击，对目标造成30点伤害。

安妮的小熊帽
吸收大量伤害并快速回复理智。
安妮的羽绒服

吸收大量伤害并快速回复理智。

快速回复理智。

泰迪熊维持1天后重新变回熊公仔，每次召唤都需要扣除40理智和30健康。

content_text:
日常b b：
如果机制不修一修的话，我觉得远远算不上op，只能说优于原有的角色···
一闪10点伤害，专属武器34点伤害；都很低，意味着她的核心输出是靠一闪清空标记带来的10%真伤（这个很牛批）。但是普攻6次才能触发标记，虽然算是合理限制，配合上一闪只能靠右键触发···结果就是，相比其它人物，八重樱占用了鼠标提升了操作复杂度，却没有提升太多强度（专属武器和一闪的低伤害算是和真伤效果抵消了）；有突进，但没脱战没霸体，面对蜂后狼王很容易被小弟围殴致死，这就很难受。当然，大招是牛批的——但5天的限制很蛋疼。

content_text:
I love this mod, but I'm running into one definite mod-specific bug and one that me and my team suspect but don't know for sure is due to this mod.
1. As others have mentioned the images aren't showing anymore for potatoes and onions, raw or cooked. Not only that but the names aren't showing either.
2. We suspect it might be causing the game to break when used in farming. We don't usually start building farms until the 2nd year. We're there on our new game now and I built a farm and immediately the network shut down. We didn't know what did it at first. Today I built a farm to test and it was fine. The second I planted a seed in it, it crashed. Definitely the farm and this is the only mod we have that interferes with the farm structure. The fact that it waits for the seed to be planted before crashing also indicates to me that it's this mod.

When using this mod with another mod that auto-open gift drops, a race condition is created between whether this mod or the other mod detects a gift drop first. To prevent such issues, you will have to make a choice between either using this mod or the other mod.

content_text:
@Lightningtow
The mod environment is sandboxed, so it wouldn't be possible to make the taskbar icon flash nor have the game send a system notification.
If you don't want to have drops auto-opened or periodically check the window for a drop, you could make a simple mod to play a more audible, repeating sound when a drop is available. But, that won't be something that's added to this mod.
A simple way to do this would be to loop the sound when the "giftreceiverupdate" event is pushed, then modify the "RevealItem" function in giftitempopup.lua to stop the sound when the drop is opened.  Hope that helps.
content_html:
@Lightningtow
The mod environment is sandboxed, so it wouldn't be possible to make the taskbar icon flash nor have the game send a system notification.

If you don't want to have drops auto-opened or periodically check the window for a drop, you could make a simple mod to play a more audible, repeating sound when a drop is available. But, that won't be something that's added to this mod.

A simple way to do this would be to loop the sound when the "giftreceiverupdate" event is pushed, then modify the "RevealItem" function in giftitempopup.lua to stop the sound when the drop is opened. Hope that helps.

content_text:
@fish'n milk
Skins that are automatically granted by the game (such as Complimentary rarity and Event rarity items) have a drop timestamp of 0. The game uses unix epoch for times, so a timestamp of 0 equals "January 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC" (or your time zone equivalent).
See:
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Epoch_(computing)

content_text:
@Ma3AqpAkA
That's incorrect. Data for multiple Klei accounts on a single computer aren't mixed.
The countdown timer is standard across all accounts because every account's daily and weekly drops reset at the same time. So, that countdown is identical for every account.
The data for the weekly drops counter and history is stored locally on your computer. Each account's weekly drops are stored separately in the "<DST Directory>/data/" folder under its own json file. Each file is distinguished by its unique Klei Account ID, KUID (with filename "dropsdata_<KUID>.json"). Do note that this file isn't synced between different computers and only counts drops that happen while the mod is enabled.
Finally, for the full Curio Cabinet Skins List, that data isn't stored locally. Instead it's called directly from your Klei's account inventory.

I suggest you also let the Russian translation mod's authors know of your freezing issue as it could be caused by the Cyrillic fonts they use.

content_text:
@amateur flamingo
Can you clarify which screen your game is freezing on? Are you not even able to get to the login screen? That screen should have a Mods Installed warning pop up. On that popup, you can click on Disable Mods.
If you aren't even able to get to that screen. Then try unsubscribing from both this and the Russian translation mod on the Steam workshop. Load up the game, go into your mod menu, and make sure all mods are disabled (click apply).
If your game still freezes after disabling, then you should try validating your Steam installation of DST. This can be done by right clicking on DST in your Steam library, then go to Properties, then Local Files, then "Verify integrity of game files".
Otherwise, if your game no longer freezes, re-subscribe to the two mods on Steam. Then, re-enable both mods and click apply. Both mods should run without conflict. If this is not the case, please report back.

content_text: Started using this mod on my dedicated server and fell in love with the glowing bottles.  So I decided I wanted to light up my whole camp as well as a few key farming areas.  As we (3-5 of us playing at any given time) were approaching day 50 we started experiencing lots of lag spikes.  It got increasingly bad as each day went on.  It took a lot of trouble shooting but I feel confident that it was due to the amount of glowing bottles I had on the server as the lag was gettign worse and worse every day (because I kept placing more and more bottles as I gathered fireflys).  By around day 100 I had 48 glowing bottles.  Even after a fresh server restart the lag hit us hard within 3-5 minutes.  We made the decision to hammer all the hard work of gathering, making, & strategicaly placing the glowing bottles.  We destroyed all but 5 that were lighting up our storrage cellars.  A fresh server reboot and it's now been 3 in game days lag free.

content_text: Wow, I didn't know you were just starting to play Don't Starve. You're doing a pretty good job with Udonge for someone with little modding experience. I love the Sanity approach you took with her, that "Lunatic Moon Rabbit" persona. But I feel like she has no way to fight back her lower sanity. Wigfrid can fight to restore some of hers; Willow gains sanity by being around fires. Those characters with low sanity have a method of figthing back. However, Udonge doesn't; only carrots, which puts her at a terrible position during Winter and Summer. Even more so because she can't sleep. Since night is the worst time for her, maybe something like a red aura that lights her surroundings (because of her Lunatic Red Eyes) can help her get resources, chop evergreens or even fight without the need of preparing a campfire or a torch. There are lots of possiblities regarding the sanity stat. Nonetheless, I love the essence you've put into our beloved Moon Rabbit. Keep up the good work.

content_text:
1，作者做了一种灯具，是摆放在地面上的（作用类似于路灯）。黄昏时灯会亮，黎明时会关掉。
2，你可以在设置里面自行配置。
路灯的颜色可选（四种，蓝色，红色，绿色，白色），默认是蓝色的。
路灯是否像火堆一样需要燃料才能持久亮（可以选择需要投放燃料）。默认是不需要消耗燃料的。
路灯的制作配方：
①简单制作=1岩石 +3小树枝+1萤火虫+1绳子。
②正常制作=1月岩石+3小树枝+1萤火虫+1绳子。
③困难制作=2月岩石+3小树枝+1萤火虫+2绳子。
（PS：非常喜欢这个MOD并希望可以持久更新，做的想真正的路灯的造型一样更好）
（PPS：支持作者请点赞订阅）
（PPPS：不机翻有益于身体健康）

Regarding placement radius, it seems to be controlled in
Map:CanDeployRecipeAtPoint()
, where is refers to the recipe's
min_spacing
parameter.
Default radius is 3.2, Chest has 1 and Icebox 1.5, I've set it to 1.5/1.25/1, depending on recipe difficulty.
Here is a patch that fixes this:
http://pastebin.com/VBiTDFXb
Here is full
modmain.lua
with
Recipe
replaced with
AddRecipe
, as it's now recommended usage, and whitespace reformatting:
http://pastebin.com/ymTFYmcz
Also, what are your thoughts on dropping resources when the light gets destroyed, like it is with other structures?
content_html:

content_text:
关于技能打到海象时会导致崩溃的bug，看了一下日志显示获取combat属性的时候取到了空值，具体在scripts\prefabs\mudrock.lua的207行，发现出错是获取了实例的combat组件，结合前面的TheSim:FindEntities函数，推测是过滤的tag不够充分，导致获取到了没combat组件的实例。
解决起来也简单，先判断一下是否有combat属性即可，具体可以在安装饥荒的steam库的文件夹下找到workshop\content\322330\2968760008\scripts\prefabs\mudrock.lua，将207行由
if targ.components.combat.hiteffectsymbol then
改为
if  targ.components.combat ~= nil and targ.components.combat.hiteffectsymbol then
记得将服务器里所有玩家的文件都修改，如果开专服将ugcmods/下的对应文件也要修改。

content_text: About 煎炸岩輝魚尊のことですが、各種類の魚のお肉が何肉単位として計算するかがポイントです。一般池(POND)で釣れた魚は基本0.5単位で、鍋(POT)は4個スロット全部池魚で埋めてもただの魚2単位、キノコと蜂蜜が入れられなくなっちゃう。だから海(SEA)で魚を釣り、1肉単位の海魚を2尾使い、キノコと蜂蜜また入れれば、煎炸岩輝魚尊が作れるようになるよ。(ちなみに海釣りポイント:1、時間帯によって餌を変える。2、餌を魚近くキャスティングした後、マウス右クリック長押し、餌が海辺か船に直ぐつくところに来たら、かかり待ち。かかったらもうすぐ引き上げ収穫でおk！)

content_text:
((Imma comment about all of the Haruz style characters here a little bit, hope that's ok <3 ))
Personally I love each and every one of the characters.  Not only are they fitting with the artwork of don't starve, and very nicely done I may say, but they have relatable little stories with one another, that extra umph.
Each of them is pretty nice, however I've noticed that the other 3 characters like this one have an insane amount of speed.  I personally hope the speed is nerfed to match that of wolfgang's speed at max hunger, to provide a little more fair playing field.  Without the speed buff, I think Haruz is very fairly balanced.
Wonderful art style, lovely story to it, keep it up!
PS : The magic glasses from the bunny, is incredibly over powered, not only will you 'never' go insane, and I mean that, but they can be passed to others in DST, making sanity something that nobody has a problem with.

content_text:
我帮你们在评论里找出来了：
单人联机完成“救世主”成就的问题：
还是要使用控制台，输入：
c_spawn("wilson")
作用是在鼠标所在位置生成一个AI威尔逊，生成出来后等他死亡后救活就好了。
你必须是主机或者是管理员才能正常使用命令，否则召唤出来的东西只是一个样子。另外如果已经是主机或者管理员，在飘号键的输入框的左侧，需要显示“控制器”三个字才能正常输入命令，按下Ctrl可以显示和隐藏“控制器”三个字，一般在按了粘贴的快捷键“Ctrl+V”之后，因为也按了Ctrl，所以很容易就把“控制器”取消掉了。
删除代码是c_select() c_sel():Remove()作用是删除鼠标所指的物品。

柴柴，我能不能修改一下这个mod，就我们自己玩，为了方便队友订阅，会发布，但是会标注原作者。如果一周内无回复，我就先行发布了。如果发布后有异议，请联系我，我可以下架。谢谢！
主要修改方向是削弱，mod总共有149点成就，其中一半以上都比较容易获得，而奖励太强了，比如自然回血和自然回脑居然只需要2点成就，而自然回脑只要点2下，就不惧黄昏了。众所周知，一个游戏一旦变得过于简单，比如开挂，就会索然无味，我觉得这个mod很有趣，但是不想失去原有的游戏趣味，所以才想自己平衡一下。我想全面提高奖励所需的成就点，并降低部分成就获得点数。

主要修改方向是削弱，mod总共有149点成就，其中一半以上都比较容易获得，而奖励太强了，比如自然回血和自然回脑居然只需要2点成就，而自然回脑只要点2下，就不惧黄昏了。众所周知，一个游戏一旦变得过于简单，比如开挂，就会索然无味，我觉得这个mod很有趣，但是不想失去原有的游戏趣味，所以才想自己平衡一下。我想全面提高奖励所需的成就点，并降低部分成就获得点数。

content_text: i think the problem with the night vision is that it triggers "once night starts" but not if night is already in progress before the effect can activate, such as joining a server that is already at nighttime, the reason it doesnt work underground is because regardless of the day night cycle, underground always registers as nighttime constantly, so the effect never detects night "starting" because the cycle is always stuck like that :/ (this may not be accurate though, all i know is that joining a server mid-nighttime causes the effect to not activate until the next night cycles around, and the caves do count as a seperate server than the overworld, and are eternal night), also, bit of a note, other players are protected from charlie just by being anywhere within a massive radius around the person playing nightmare, im not complaining at all mind you, i just think its cool that one player can act as a portable night light for a large group at once by illuminating an entire base

更新日志：
1. 修复 Musha（2398672953）模组大部分盔甲都视为背包的 bug（注意，由于本人认为既然模组物品加了 backpack 标签，那就应该是背包，所以如果出现你认为是护甲却放在背包栏的情况，请告诉作者，我将进行手动兼容）

2.流型的存在时间太不可控，有时候好不容易堆属性摸了五个大爹穿好装备，然后探险途中没看到提示，没能及时用三技能刷新时间，时间一到地上就没了，是真的很难受。
3.个人脑洞就是增加个“热水壶”饰品：佩戴会减少耐久但是流型不会随时间消失，同时缪缪回复能量时间加快，摘下或者耐久为零后流形才开始计时；耐久为零不会消失但是不具有效果，可以通过“吸收”流形或者战术点来补充耐久。具体操作就是鼠标拿起“热水壶”然后对着流形/战术点右键，对应的流形/战术点就会消失（时间耗尽），同时恢复一定耐久。这样既能解决流形存在时间问题又能解决战术点太多装不下满地放的问题。
谢谢作者大大的辛苦付出~

仙法·救苦渡厄：按下X键使用（20秒CD，15秒持续时间，80点元素能量消耗），对周围敌人造成90点伤害并施加度厄真符效果。
-度厄真符效果在造成伤害前施加。因此七七的元素爆发一旦命中敌人，她可以直接回复生命值。

中文翻译
Chinese Translation
兔子笼基本上算是一个兔子农场。
如果装满3只兔子并且保持没有减少的话，3天内收获最多3次。
站在笼子旁边时能保持清醒。
把怪物肉喂给兔子得到胡须。

content_text:
高天之歌：
-按下Z键（冷却时间6秒），在温迪面朝方向前一段距离召唤风域，造成270%攻击力的伤害并附带一段时间的击飞效果。当风域击中至少一个目标时温迪将恢复3点元素能量。
-按住Z键（冷却时间15秒），以自身为中心唤出更大的风域，造成380%攻击力的伤害并附带一段时间的击飞效果。当风域击中至少一个目标时温迪将恢复4点元素能量。
风神之诗：按下X键（冷却时间15秒，持续时间8秒，消耗60点元素能量），射出千风汇聚而成的箭矢，在前方造出巨大的暴风。暴风会持续卷入周围敌人并不断造成最多20次的35%攻击力的伤害。（仅在装备弓箭时才能施放）
-以下技能默认处于关闭状态
弦发的苍风：瞄准射击时会额外发射两发分裂箭，分别造成原本33%的伤害。

如何放置轨道:
——建造并装备轨道工具;
这个工具有一个库存来放置铁轨(类似于沃尔特弹弓)
-将铁路轨道放置在工具库中，放置助手将出现
——当你用这个工具铸造时，铁轨会被放置;
如果靠近另一条铁轨，它们会排成一排。

铁路轨道工具配方:
—1年;
—2块金块;
——1矛
—工具选项卡在炼金术引擎


铁道食谱:
——6个铁轨:1个木板，1个切割石，1个燧石;
——6个浮轨:1块木板、1块石料、1个防蚊袋;
—6个助推器轨道:1块木板，1块切割石，12块金块;
—6个阻尼轨道:1块木板，1块切割石，1块木炭;
——6个反向铁轨:1块木板，1块切割石，1块猪皮
——炼金术引擎的结构标签

Thank you for continuing to update this wonderful mod.
I would like to report an issue that occurs when running the mod on Linux.
In modmain_jokers.lua, line 2,
local UpvalueHacker = GLOBAL.require "tools/UpvalueHacker"
causes an error on Linux due to case sensitivity in file paths. Since the actual file is located at scripts/tools/upvaluehacker.lua,
I suggest changing the line to
local UpvalueHacker = GLOBAL.require "tools/upvaluehacker"
for compatibility.
On Linux, file names are case-sensitive, unlike on Windows.
The error message I received was:
[string "../mods/workshop-2010472942/modmain_jokers...."]:2: module 'tools/UpvalueHacker' not found:
no field package.preload['tools/UpvalueHacker']
Thank you again for your great work on the mod. I appreciate your time and consideration.

prince:我做这个mod是因为来自峡谷的东西重新上传的街灯对我来说太亮了。对它取余。
信息:该mod还将支持峡谷的东西重新上传作为补丁在未来。然而，这给专用服务器上的客户端带来了问题。我正在调查这个问题。
——[功能]
这个模型包含了峡谷的两个路灯版本。
首先，这个mod为街灯增加了一个白天/黄昏/夜晚的循环(在洞穴中它们总是很活跃)。
这意味着它们在黄昏时打开，在拂晓时关闭。
街灯的光线被调整得更弱、更微妙。
您可以在light选项卡中找到它们。
你可以从三种不同的路灯配方中选择。

content_text:
[属性]
血量: 150
饥饿: 150
理智: 100
[技能/特性]
拔锚！: 在出生时会获得一把强大的船锚作为武器。
交给雷吧！:在工作或者是收获作物的时候会获得理智，但是如果什么都不干的话理智则会下降。
雷电之速: 移动速度上升10%。
[关于雷的船锚]
雷出生的时候会获得一把船锚作为武器，属性为48点攻击以及100点耐久，虽然比触手剑的属性要弱一些，但是通过使用燧石，雷可以恢复船锚20点的耐久度。当装备船锚时，装备者的速度会下降25%。
如果船锚坏了，或者只是单纯的想再造一把的话，可以在战斗分类下使用3个金粒，4块琢石和三条绳子制作一把。
content_html:
[属性]
血量: 150
饥饿: 150
理智: 100

[技能/特性]
拔锚！: 在出生时会获得一把强大的船锚作为武器。
交给雷吧！:在工作或者是收获作物的时候会获得理智，但是如果什么都不干的话理智则会下降。
雷电之速: 移动速度上升10%。

[关于雷的船锚]
雷出生的时候会获得一把船锚作为武器，属性为48点攻击以及100点耐久，虽然比触手剑的属性要弱一些，但是通过使用燧石，雷可以恢复船锚20点的耐久度。当装备船锚时，装备者的速度会下降25%。

如果船锚坏了，或者只是单纯的想再造一把的话，可以在战斗分类下使用3个金粒，4块琢石和三条绳子制作一把。

content_text:
原因:
崩溃发生于Mod "Display Attack Range" 的脚本 "modmain.lua"。自动诊断将其标记为"High-Risk"，表明它是最直接的嫌疑。详细堆栈追踪显示，在执行 "AdjustRangeDisplay" 函数时，一个关键变量 "sg" 的值为 "nil"，这不符合预期。根本原因是该Mod在处理 "巨大洞穴蠕虫" (worm_boss) 的攻击范围显示时，可能由于代码缺陷或与游戏本体的冲突，导致了对不存在的 "sg" 字段的访问，从而引发了这个致命错误。这里蹦了

content_text:
如果有好兄弟崩服的话可以尝试一下这个解决办法：
进入下面的这个文件夹
"Don't Starve Together\mods\workshop-613786237\scripts\components"
然后删除掉其中的" transparentonsanity.lua "文件就可以了
（这边确实解决了崩溃的问题，如果各位没有效果的话这边提前道声歉orz）
English translation：
If there is a crash,you can try to enter this folder↓
"Don't Starve Together\mods\workshop-613786237\scripts\components"
and delete " transparentonsanity.lua "
（At least it works for me.If it doesn't work for you, I apologize in advance orz）
碎碎念：这边看代码+实操感觉崩溃的原因是Skittish这个生物的生成（就是低SAN值时生成的蛇形无害影怪）因为满SAN状态的Frisk一般不会崩服，而当Frisk的SAN值降低至可以生成Skittish这个生物时就会发生崩服

content_text: Sanity drops REALLY fast when using Frisk. this isn't too problematic of an issue since hallucinations apparently run away from you. (Had a fun time watching Terrorbeaks ducking in and out to sneak a peek at Frisk) i am not sure if that bit was intentional, but the giant sanity drain isn't necessary. I love using the mod, and I love the extra crafting options, but those are the few glaring issues i have with the mod thus far.

content_text:
My second suggestion, which I'm not sure is even possible, is the following. Your structures, as I said before, look amazing, so I was wondering, where would be the sense in having two of them. Like, if I had a Yurt and a Tipi, why would I change the place I sleep depending on the time? Both look sturdy, comfy and good. So I was thinking it would be great if we had the option of having only one of them that would function as both day and night sleeping quarters.
Alternatively, if you would rather your structures remain as they are, you could implement one idea I had: to take over Pig Houses, and use them to sleep both day and night (since they are wooden houses, and not tent-like, they look even more sturdy).
Feel free to contact me if you want to discuss anything :) Once again, thank you for your mod and your time reading this.

content_text:
Greetings, and thank you for the great mod. The structures blend extremely well with the game, their art is very fitting.
I have some suggestions: Unlike the game's structures, the yurt and the tipi can't be perfectly centered on a tile of (for example) carpeted flooring. What I mean is that even if you place them on the tile's center (using Geometric Placement), visually they will look to be a bit off. This can be fixed by placing them a bit down, but then, when you rotate the view, once again, it is not centered. For contrast, if you place the game's vanilla structures on the center of a tile, they will *look* centered, no matter the angle. I know this is a weird request, but could you please make the tipi and the yurt more centered? I figured this wouldn't be too hard.

content_text:
The fix for the hunger rate bug is change lines 113 and 115 of nue.lua to this:
113: elseif food and food.components.edible and food.prefab == "trunk_winter" and inst.components.hunger.hungerrate >= (TUNING.WILSON_HUNGER_RATE * 0.86) then
115: inst.components.hunger.hungerrate = (inst.components.hunger.hungerrate * 0.95)
That will fix it so you get a 5% boost for each trunk up to three times for a max hunger rate of 85.7375% of the default Wilson's hunger rate.
content_html:
The fix for the hunger rate bug is change lines 113 and 115 of nue.lua to this:

113: elseif food and food.components.edible and food.prefab == "trunk_winter" and inst.components.hunger.hungerrate >= (TUNING.WILSON_HUNGER_RATE * 0.86) then

115: inst.components.hunger.hungerrate = (inst.components.hunger.hungerrate * 0.95)

That will fix it so you get a 5% boost for each trunk up to three times for a max hunger rate of 85.7375% of the default Wilson's hunger rate.

content_text:
If anyone is here years later and is wondering why the Winter Koalefant trunk seems to be giving a ton more hunger resistance than 5% then the answer is simple:
The base hunger rate for Nue is set at Wilson's rate which is = calories_per_day/total_day_time = 75/480 = 0.15625.
Every time you eat a Winter Koalaphant trunk the code for Nue checks to see if your hunger rate is above or equal to 0.05 and then subtracts 0.05 from it if it is.
So it goes like this:
1 Winter Trunk - Hunger rate is now 0.10625
2 Winter Trunk - Hunger rate is now 0.05625
3 Winter Trunk - Hunger rate is now 0.00625
So the final hunger rate is 0.00625/0.15625 = 0.0399... or 4% of Wilson's Hunger rate!
I'll post a fix in the next comment.

每个声称他们与鵺接触过的人，都给出了完全不同的外貌描述。看起来她能够随心所欲变换外形。
没人真正地知道她从哪儿来又到哪儿去，除了一些人。他们谈论着一颗掉落的星星，在这些小岛中的某地坠落。

凛终于来到了不饿的宇宙!
125/125/250健康/饥饿/理智
-一个伪科学机器!
像wickerbottom暂时会谈

-她也有失眠症，皇家血液不能睡在粗糙的地板上!
